answer: Alt-click (Option-click on Mac) the rendered link to reveal its markdown source. Then select and copy it. The source stays visible while your selection touches it, and it renders again once you move entirely outside it. This doesn't give you edit access to the page. If you'd rather see raw markdown all the time, run the "Editor: Toggle Markdown Syntax Rendering" command.

[1] Live Preview.md (Revealing the source)
  Revealing the source: On an editable page, moving the cursor inside a formatted element reveals its source. **Alt-click** (or **Option-click** on Mac) explicitly reveals source in both editable and read-only pages. / In a read-only page, ordinary keyboard navigation keeps links and widgets rendered. Alt/Option-click to reveal source, then select and copy it. The source stays visible while the selection touches its range. Moving entirely outside it hides the source again. Read-only access does not allow you to change the page.
